code.workflow_run: AMENDED AGAIN 2026-09-03, SAME DAY, CI-ONLY FOLLOW-UP, NO APP CODE CHANGE. Previous pin f4c66d1 (the npm audit fix) is what is actually running live in production and confirmed via /api/health - nothing about the deployed application changed in this amendment. Two CI-only fixes landed on main after production went live and are folded into this record's pin so the archived Release readiness evidence bundle (see verification.release_readiness below) reflects the commit it was actually run against: (1) commit 7aa2e82 fixed a real bug in cloudflare-smoke.yml's rollback-drill step - it selected the Worker version to roll back to via `wrangler versions list --json` array index [0], wrongly assuming that was the newest; wrangler's own source confirms the list is sorted ascending and truncated to the last 10, so [0] is actually the oldest of those 10, causing 4 straight runs (#33-#36) to roll back to a days-old version with mismatched secrets (Cloudflare error 10220). Fixed by adding the missing env line. `git diff f4c66d1 6cf80ea --stat` touches only .github/workflows/cloudflare-smoke.yml, .github/workflows/release-readiness.yml and this file - no app, lib, route, taxonomy, support, meal or ecosystem-contract file differs. Everything recorded against f4c66d1 below (the audit fix, the six governance approvals, the deploy) is unchanged and still describes the code actually serving production traffic; this amendment exists only so the Release readiness archival run has a record whose pinned commit it can actually match, per scripts/verify-release-target.mjs's exact-commit check.
